description: This file defines the RateRepositoryWrapper class which provides methods to retrieve Rate entities from underlying repository, with detection and handling of not-found cases.

classes.name: RateRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A service class that wraps around RateRepository to add not-found detection logic for Rate entities.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a single Rate by ID; throws RateNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: findMultipleWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves multiple Rates by a list of IDs; throws RateNotFoundException if any are missing.
